sum: Yiren Digital Ltd. provides financial services through an AI-powered Fintech platform in China. Its platform provides a suite of financial and lifestyle services. The company offers credit solutions, insurance brokerage, and others. The company was formerly known as Yirendai Ltd. and changed its name to Yiren Digital Ltd. in September 2019. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China. Yiren Digital Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of CreditEase Holdings (Cayman) Limited.
ceo: Ms. Mei  Zhao (Chief Executive Officer of Yiren Credit)
